facts.summary: Authoring tracks driven by player handles; cumulative deformation relative to rest, separately accumulate translation/rotation/scale and form matrix at end. Multiblender handles runtime animations and applies deforms on top.
Baking removes edit deform tracks into a new base mesh; runtime animation such as mouth animation can be retained with lower bone count and retargeting to the changed base pose.
Slides distinguish authored and reduced runtime skeleton and mention skeletal and blendshape animation; mesh and runtime animations retargeted to runtime skeleton.
